# Manitham HRMS

> Manitham HRMS is a cloud-based HR management system for Indian businesses — employee management, attendance, leave, payroll, performance, recruitment and employee self-service in one platform, with an AI-powered WhatsApp assistant for HR questions.

Manitham HRMS is built around Indian statutory compliance (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS) and also serves teams in the US, UK, Singapore, Malaysia and Australia with country-specific payroll compliance.

## Product

- [HRMS Software](https://hrms.work/hrms-software): overview of the full platform
- [Employee Management](https://hrms.work/employee-management): employee records, documents, org structure
- [Attendance Management](https://hrms.work/attendance-management): biometric, GPS and web/mobile attendance tracking
- [Leave Management](https://hrms.work/leave-management): leave policies, approvals, balances
- [Payroll Software](https://hrms.work/payroll-software): salary processing, PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS
- [Performance Management](https://hrms.work/performance-management): goals, KPIs, appraisal cycles
- [Recruitment Software](https://hrms.work/recruitment): job postings, candidate pipeline, onboarding handoff
- [Employee Self Service](https://hrms.work/employee-self-service): ESS portal for attendance, leave, payslips
- [AI WhatsApp Assistant](https://hrms.work/ai-whatsapp-assistant): AI-powered HR answers over WhatsApp
- [HR Compliance](https://hrms.work/hr-compliance): statutory payroll compliance for India
- [Pricing](https://hrms.work/pricing): plans and pricing tiers
